image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a black hockey puck resting on a dark, textured surface (likely ice or a mat). The puck features a prominent silver and blue circular logo with the text 'SAINTS' in a stylized font, accompanied by a fleur-de-lis symbol. The puck has a matte black rubber body with visible circumferential ridges on the side edge.

artifact_observations.reasoning: While the main 'SAINTS' text is legible, the surrounding arc text is nonsensical and malformed, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear branding or legal disclaimers found on real pucks.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition between the printed silver area and the black rubber is slightly soft and lacks the crisp edge definition typically seen in hot-stamped or printed puck logos. There is minor bleeding.
